title: Law to help youth find jobs or schooling after incarceration
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office of Criminal Justice to create a program helping young people aged 13 to 24 find employment or educational opportunities after release from ACS custody or incarceration. The office would aim to enroll eligible youth while still in custody and coordinate with the Department of Correction and ACS to track outcomes. It would report annually to the Council starting January 1 each year.
